description:
FOUND s439 (Fable review of s438g/#452) by probes vs perl 5.40.3; all three
PRE-EXISTING (identical on a d0b52e9 worktree), so #452 is approved as shipped --
this is its residue, and it is ONE family: the handle NAME is never canonicalised.

  print main::STDOUT "a\n";            # perl: a        PCL: "The function main::pl-STDOUT is undefined"
  printf main::STDOUT "%s\n", "b";     # same
  open(Foo::H1, "<", $f); <Foo::H1>    # perl: reads    PCL: READ error "Package Foo does not exist" -- whole file
                                       #   (the open/close sites emit a BARE symbol `Foo::H1`; #452 quoted only the
                                       #    readline and print-:fh sites, and method.t's `Colour::H1` loads only
                                       #    because `package Colour` exists as a CL package)
  open(main::FH, ...); print FH "x";   # perl: same handle   PCL: FH unknown to the print slot (registered as "main::FH")

perl's rule: the standard handles (STDIN STDOUT STDERR ARGV ARGVOUT ENV INC _) are
forced into main:: from ANY package, so `main::STDOUT` is `STDOUT`; every other
bareword handle is qualified with the CURRENT package, so `main::FH` in package
main IS `FH`, and `Foo::H1` is a handle in Foo whether or not a `package Foo`
statement exists (the stash autovivifies).

FIX SHAPE (rule 11 -- one place): canonicalise the perl handle NAME at the
Environment seam -- `Pl::Environment::is_filehandle` / `add_filehandle` (the
registry is keyed by literal spelling today) -- `main::X` -> `X`, and emit the
handle as a QUOTED NAME (or a pipe-quoted symbol that does not need the CL
package to exist) at the open/close/eof/binmode sites the same way #452 did for
readline and the print slot.  `_bareword_fh_p` (ExprToCL) is the predicate #452
widened; grep for the other callers of the handle-emission path before adding a
branch.

BAR: probes (the four lines above + `print Foo::STDOUT "x"`, which perl does NOT
redirect to STDOUT -- the inverse), Pl/t/punct-array-glob-01.t rows beside the
#452 ones, corpus-diff + the 951-file A/B (method.t:672 is the one live site of
the family), gate.  Zero corpus occurrences otherwise -> the s371 rule, rows + an
inverse run on a worktree.


DONE s443f (Opus, agent F round 4), commit 4c32128, ff-merged s444.  ONE seam: Pl::Environment::canon_filehandle_name (registry key AND emitted spelling; is_filehandle/add_filehandle/ExprToCL::_fh_sym all ask it), fh_bareword_shape replaces four regex copies, readline/select emitters routed through _fh_sym.  THE ASYMMETRY probed: forced-main handles resolve in main:: unqualified from every package, but an EXPLICIT qualifier names that package's own glob (print Foo::STDOUT = undef, emitted pipe-quoted so it cannot reach the short-name fallback).  Fable re-probed print/printf main::STDOUT, open Foo::H1 (no package Foo), open main::FH + print FH, the Foo::STDOUT inverse -- all identical to perl.  Gate-SET scan run by F itself: 638x2, 0 verdict moves.  Residues filed: #529 #530 #531 #532.
subject: A package-QUALIFIED bareword filehandle, the three spellings #452 left: `print main::STDOUT LIST` is a CALL; the registry is keyed by the SPELLING (`open(main::FH)` vs `print FH`); `open(Foo::H1)` with no `package Foo` is a CL READ error (whole file lost)
